messages:
alex (PM): Heads-up: new pilot request from Acme — private onramp with customer-managed KMS/HSM, dedicated capacity, and ~50ms p95 latency target for chat. Need cross-team deps mapped.

matt (Eng-runtime): 50ms p95 for chat with long context is aggressive. What token lengths? model constraints?

alex (PM): Worst-case 6k tokens; avg ~512. They prefer high-quality model but could accept a slightly smaller variant if it meets SLA. Also need audit logs and data residency.

priya (Infra): HSM + VPC peering ok but depends on vendor lead time. Provisioning + certs ~4w; colo path +2w. Dedicated pools need reservation window.

sara (Security): If keys are customer-managed we need an architecture review, KMS integration tests, and key rotation policy. Legal may be needed.

alex (PM): They require customer-managed keys. If HSM slips, fallback to Redwood-hosted keys for pilot only (with consent).

matt (Eng-runtime): For perf at 6k tokens we need aggressive KV cache warm paths, smaller quant config, and batching. I can prototype a quantized variant and list compatibility notes.

toni (Product Ops): Product okay with graceful degrade fallback (higher latency or lower-quality). Need SRE + sales signoff.

jon (SRE): Fallback routing ok with headroom + prewarm triggers. Suggest prewarm policy and canary rollout. Autoscale warm-up depends on instance type.

matt (Eng-runtime): Proposed canary snippet: ```yaml
canary: true
percent: 5
monitoring: [latency_p95, error_rate, cost_delta]
rollback_thresholds:
  latency_p95: +20%
  error_rate: 0.5%
```

priya (Infra): Need traffic profile to size pool and set prewarm thresholds.

alex (PM): Sending traffic estimate today. Target timeline: 6w if security + infra align.

sara (Security): Send threat model and dataflow doc to speed review. I'll provide templates.

toni (Product Ops): Action items: alex -> traffic & dataflow, matt -> perf prototype & perf delta, priya -> infra lead time & network steps, sara -> signoff checklist, jon -> canary & prewarm runbook.

alex (PM): Creating ownership table and looping in sales. Scheduling quick sync.

matt (Eng-runtime): Note: fallback model must preserve output schema/function-call compatibility; will list incompatibilities.

jon (SRE): Ops checklist: health endpoints, trace header propagation, circuit-breaker on queue length, manual scale steps, rollback runbook.

priya (Infra): Tentative infra prep week 3 post-approval; HSM vendor or colo may shift schedule.

sara (Security): I'll prioritize threat model template and KMS test plan. Legal contact queued.

toni (Product Ops): Soft launch bar proposal: p95 <= 75ms, error_rate < 0.2%, nightly audit logs delivered, HSM audit proofs. Agree?

alex (PM): Agreed. Scheduling 30-min triage Friday to finalize.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: #onramp-acme-sync Friday 12:30pm PST.

matt (Eng-runtime): I'll bring a short perf demo. Priya/sara/jon bring blockers.

alex (PM): Link to working doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/runway/acme-onramp — use comments.

toni (Product Ops): Ping me with updates before Friday. :thumbsup:

jon (SRE): Adding alert thresholds to the doc.

matt (Eng-runtime): Perf prototype due EOD Thu, will attach numbers.

alex (PM): Main risks: HSM lead time and prewarm behavior at 6k tokens. Keeping this thread canonical for deps and decisions.
